name: clothing-extraction
description: A visual production toolkit for faithful fashion imagery, garment details, and high-fidelity reference lettering reconstruction.

interface.shortDescription: Create faithful fashion imagery, garment details, and reference-matched typography.
interface.longDescription: A collection of visual production skills for fashion e-commerce imagery, garment macro details, and high-fidelity lettering reconstruction from reference images, with evidence-led workflows and quality checks.
defaultPrompt: 按 $clothing-extraction 执行，提取这件衣服。
用 $clothing-extraction 把模特上衣转成白底平铺商品图。
用 $clothing-detail 为这件服装生成四张独立细节图。
按 $font-reference-replica v3.0 执行，复刻参考图中的标题字体。
用 $font-reference-replica v3.0 重建这组文字，输出黑字透明底 PNG。
